question: __________ is the father of the modern periodic table.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dmitri Mendeleev**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dmitri Mendeleev** was a Russian chemist who was credited with the creation of the modern periodic table.
 
• He arranged the elements based on their atomic weights and properties and left gaps for the elements that had not been discovered at that time.
